answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 9123 Country: GY Title: Is it permissible for a muslim school run by ulama to have in one class boys seated in front and girls at the back? Question: Is it permissible for a muslim school run by ulama to have in one class boys seated in front and girls at the back? Answer ID: 9123 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1553/1305=L/1429) There is no wrong if the girl students are minor, but if the girls are adolescent or mature then it is not enough to have them at back seats, rather there should be partition between them and the boys. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
